Начинаем с необученной сети: два скрытых: We start with an untrained network: two hidden layers of 64 neurons with random weights, and only the ${DATA.N} gray training points of the two spirals on the scene. Click "Train": each click gives the network another 100 epochs (the slider changes the number). The task is done when the loss on the plot drops below 0.234. Along the way you can see what the network can already do: every 25 epochs it takes 300 random noise points, removes the noise from them and puts the result on the scene in orange.

It barely goes lower: even after 800 epochs it stays around 0.225. Part of the noise can't be guessed in principle: at low noise it's unclear where on the spiral the point started, and the network outputs the mean over all candidates. The slow tail of the curve is the spirals: the network is learning the fine structure, and it emerges on the scene. The network predicts the noise, not the clean point: that's how DDPM works.
Начинаем с ${NGEN} случайных точек гаусс: We start with ${NGEN} random points of Gaussian noise: an orange cloud with no spirals in it. Click the button: in 100 DDPM steps the network removes the noise from the points, and you'll see them move from noise to data (the thin lines are the paths of ${KEEP} of them). The result counts when the points land on the spirals: at least 90% on the spirals and 40 to 60% on each. Alongside on the same scene is the "noise → point" regression: the same network without the step number, trained with MSE to output a data point from random noise; it gets the same ${NGEN} starting noise points.

Reduce the number of steps and generate again until the cloud loses its shape: on large steps the points collapse toward the center. The result is the number of steps at which fewer than 25% of the points remain outside the dashed circle, while the data has half there.

На ${nWord(r.S, 'шаге', 'шагах', 'шагах': At ${nWord(r.S, 'step', 'steps', 'steps')}, ${pc(r.A.outer)} of the points remain outside the circle, while the data has half. The shape holds down to ${nWord(r.sweep.Sstar, 'step', 'steps', 'steps')}. A DDPM step is built from the estimate of the clean point and fresh noise. On a large step the estimate is a blurred mean, and the predicted noise, which holds the direction of motion, is almost entirely replaced with fresh noise. That's why the cloud collapses toward the center. The same happens with images: on CIFAR-10 this sampler at 10 steps gives FID 41.07 versus 4.73 at 1000 steps (the lower the FID, the closer the images are to real ones). Why, we'll check in the next mission.
На 8 шагах DDPM терял форму. Объяснений: At 8 steps DDPM lost the shape. There are two explanations. First: the network is undertrained, and on large steps it lacks accuracy. Second: the stepping method is to blame; DDPM replaces the predicted noise with fresh noise at every step. Pick an explanation and test it: both panels use the same ${NGEN} starting noise points and the same network, DDPM on the left, DDIM on the right, with steps without fresh noise. Generate both and find a number of steps no more than 10 at which DDIM holds the shape (at least 80% on the spirals, at least 25% outside the circle) while DDPM no longer does.

Сеть одна и та же, а на ${nWord(r.S, 'ша: The network is the same, yet at ${nWord(r.S, 'step', 'steps', 'steps')} DDIM has ${pc(r.B.outer)} of the points outside the circle and DDPM has ${pc(r.A.outer)}. So the second explanation is right: it's the stepping method. At η = 0 the predicted noise isn't thrown away but carried to the next step, and the path is deterministic. The first explanation can be tested directly too: train the network more and generate at 8 steps again; DDPM's cloud still collapses. On CIFAR-10, DDIM at 10, 20, 50, 100 and 1000 steps gives FID 13.36, 6.84, 4.67, 4.16 and 4.04; 50–100 DDIM steps are almost lossless. Robots do exactly this: Diffusion Policy (lesson 1.5) uses DDIM at 10 steps, π0 (lesson 3.6) 10 flow matching steps, GR00T N1 (lesson 3.7) 4.

Without guidance ${pc(r.w0, 1)} of the points landed on spiral 1. The stronger the guidance, the more confidently the points land on the requested spiral, but the fewer of its parts they cover: the points crowd where spiral 1 looks least like spiral 2. At very large w the points overshoot the spiral. For images the best FID comes at w = 0.1–0.3 and the best IS at w ≥ 4: the same trade of diversity for precision. For robots: Decision Diffuser uses a scale of 1.2–1.8, the authors of π*0.6 (a later Physical Intelligence model; lesson 3.8) warn that large weights make behavior aggressive, π0.7 takes β ∈ {1.3, 1.7, 2.2}. The Diffusion Policy and π0 papers use no guidance.

Before that there's a window where the network already generates points near the training ones but doesn't repeat them yet. Early stopping relies on this window: Bonnaire et al. showed that the time to memorization grows with the sample size.

На ${r.N} точках за 8000 шагов копий тол: On ${r.N} points, after 8000 steps only ${pc(r.cEnd)} are copies: the network doesn't have time to memorize that many points, although the ideal denoiser copies ${pc(r.ideal)}. For images the transition from memorization to generalization starts around N = 1000 (Kadkhodaie et al.), and on CIFAR-10 it's 0% copies on 50,000 images and more than 90% on 1,000 (Gu et al.). Diffusion Policy on small data behaves like a lookup table: even for a photo of a cat it outputs a trajectory from training (preprint 2505.05787).

У данных два правильных ответа. Чем гене: The data has two correct answers. How does a generator differ from regression?
Ничем: обе модели выдают ответ, ближайши: It doesn't: both models output the answer closest to all examples at once
Регрессия выдаёт среднее показанных отве: Regression outputs the mean of the answers shown; a generator outputs one of them, and a different one run after run
Генератор выдаёт оба ответа сразу, а роб: A generator outputs both answers at once, and the robot picks the better one
Минимум среднеквадратичной ошибки — сред: The minimum of mean squared error is the mean of the answers shown, and the mean of two detours leads into the kettle. A generator outputs a sample: a point on one of the spirals, or one of the detours. In the section on Ada's actions the generated actions landed in two clusters, while regression on the same starting noises landed in the kettle band.
Зачем данные портят шумом постепенно, за: Why corrupt the data with noise gradually, over many steps, rather than turn noise into data in one go?
Так данные занимают меньше памяти: So the data takes less memory
За один раз не получается: такая сеть сн: One go doesn't work: such a network outputs the mean again; but a network can learn to remove a small portion of noise, and on the forward path the correct answer is known for every step
Чтобы шум в конце получился гауссовым: So that the noise at the end comes out Gaussian
Регрессия «шум → точка» в лаборатории кл: The "noise → point" regression in the lab puts a cloud at the center: you can't guess the right point from random noise, and the loss minimum is the mean. The forward path serves as a workbook: at every step we know which noise was added, and the network learns to guess it at any noise level. The reverse path is made of the same small steps.
Что сеть делает на обучении и что — на г: What does the network do during training, and what during generation?
На обучении запоминает точки данных, на: During training it memorizes the data points; during generation it picks one of them
На обучении по зашумлённой точке и номер: During training it learns to guess the added noise from a noised point and the step number; during generation it predicts the noise for a random cloud, and part of it is removed step by step
На обучении и на генерации одно и то же:: The same thing in training and generation: it turns noise into a point in one pass
Обучение идёт только по прямому пути: се: Training runs only along the forward path: the network sees a noised point and the step number, and the correct answer, the added noise, is known. During generation the same predicted noise points toward the data, and the cloud walks the reverse path. The network doesn't store the data; the ideal denoiser from section 3 does, which is why it only copies.
Сеть одна и та же. Откуда у генератора р: The network is the same. Where do the generator's different answers come from?
Сеть на каждом запуске обучается заново: The network is retrained on every run
Старт — новое случайное облако: на какой: The start is a new random cloud: which arm a point lands on is decided by its starting position, and for some stepping methods also by fresh noise along the way
Ответы на самом деле одинаковые, различи: The answers are actually the same; the differences are rounding error
В миссии про бассейны два старта ближе 0: In the basin mission two starts within 0.25 of each other landed on different spirals: the basin boundary runs between them. At high noise the denoiser pulls all points to the center, then the start picks an arm, and denoising carries the point to it. For Ada this is the choice of detour: left or right.
Почему генерация стоит дорого по времени: Why is generation expensive in time?
Сеть большая, и один её проход занимает: The network is big, and a single pass takes seconds
Каждый шаг обратного пути — полный прохо: Every step of the reverse path is a full pass of the network, and there are tens or hundreds of steps
Нужно перебрать все обучающие точки: You have to go through all the training points
Один проход маленькой сети быстрый, но в: One pass of a small network is fast, but the original DDPM model takes 1000 steps. Robots cut them to 4–20: they step without fresh noise (DDIM), use accurate solvers, or distill the network. In the lab, at 6–8 steps the cloud collapsed to the center only with steps that add fresh noise.
Зачем генератору условие и что меняет ег: Why does a generator need a condition, and what does amplifying it (guidance) change?
Условие ускоряет генерацию, а усиление д: The condition speeds up generation, and amplification makes it even faster
Условие говорит, какой ответ нужен: номе: The condition says which answer is needed: the spiral number, the camera observation; amplification makes the answers match the condition more precisely but poorer: the points crowd into a few spots
Условие нужно только картинкам, роботу о: Only images need a condition; a robot doesn't
Роботу нужно не любое правдоподобное дей: A robot needs not just any plausible action but one that fits what the camera sees. In the experiment, without amplification a noticeable share of the points landed off the requested spiral; with amplification precision rose while coverage of the spiral fell, and at large weights the points overshot the spiral. For robots, large weights make behavior aggressive.
Генератор всегда придумывает новые приме: Does a generator always invent new examples?
Да: сгенерированное никогда не совпадает: Yes: what it generates never coincides with the training points
Нет: на малых данных и при долгом обучен: No: on small data and with long training the network starts repeating the training examples, and the ideal denoiser outputs nothing else
Нет: он всегда повторяет обучающие приме: No: it always repeats the training examples
В разделе про память сеть на восьми точк: In the memorization section, the network on eight points copied more than half of the samples by the end of training, and on 128 points fewer than a quarter. For a robot this means that a diffusion policy on a dozen demonstrations may replay the recorded motions instead of generalizing.
Что меняется, когда вместо точек на спир: What changes when the generator is given robot actions instead of points on spirals?
Нужна другая модель: диффузия работает т: A different model is needed: diffusion only works with images and points
В устройстве сети ничего: действие — так: Nothing in the network's design: an action is just numbers too, and from noise you get actions from the options shown, not their average
Генератор начинает выдавать среднее, как: The generator starts outputting the mean, like regression
